async function have5RawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // This function checks if the bot possesses at least five iron ingots. If not, it calculates how many more are required. It then verifies if enough raw iron is available to meet the target. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source among several candidates. If no fuel is found, it throws an error. Finally, it ensures a furnace is present or places one, then smelts the necessary raw iron into ingots.
